info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Fiduciary Agreement Management API
info.description: The Fiduciary Agreement Management API facilitates the creation and management of fiduciary agreements within the banking and lending context. This API allows financial institutions to establish, track, and modify fiduciary agreements accurately. Common consumers include bank personnel, loan officers, and compliance teams who require a streamlined process for managing these critical agreements. This functionality helps ensure regulatory compliance and enhances operational efficiency within financial services.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new fiduciary agreement, which is essential for deposit lending transactions. Ensure that all required information is provided in the request body to successfully establish the agreement.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a fiduciary agreement under the deposit lending operations. It requires the necessary parameters in JSON format to successfully process the agreement.
